headline: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited: Cessation
sum: Cessation - Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited has informed the Exchange regarding cessation of Mr. Ajay Kumar Gupta as CEO of erstwhile Century Pulp and Paper ( CPP ) business division on account of sale of the CPP business division to ITC…
detail: Cessation - Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited has informed the Exchange regarding cessation of Mr. Ajay Kumar Gupta as CEO of erstwhile Century Pulp and Paper ( CPP ) business division on account of sale of the CPP business division to ITC Limited as a going concern on slump sale basis and therefore, he has ceased as Senior Management Personnel ( SMP ) of the Company w.e.f. 16th September, 2026

sources.name: NSE filing - Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
